title: Let Naam swallow the smaller fears
summary: Absorption in Naam makes the lesser fears fall away. Let mercy become more believable than the threat.
takeaway: Let mercy become more believable than the threat.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: Absorption in Naam makes the lesser fears fall away.
source.lifeApplication: When smaller fears multiply, return to Naam until they lose force.
